entities.name: Stanton Macdonald-Wright
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stanton Macdonald-Wright, was a modern American artist. He was a co-founder of Synchromism, an early abstract, color-based mode of painting, which was the first American avant-garde art movement to receive international attention.
